provenance.notes: Original Divider style generator and cssinjs serializer; style-hook registration is replaced by capture. Static DOM mirrors Divider source classes and rail/content structure. No native implementation values are read. Geometry is relative to each root. Explicit titleMargin samples exercise the deprecated source orientationMargin prop.
